why: every other harness in this lane measures what the analyzer produced; this measures what it did not, with the denominator taken from the parse tree so it cannot move when the analyzer does
method: call sites counted by walking the tree-sitter parse tree for `call` nodes, split by whether a `function_definition` encloses them; compared against the analyzer's emitted `calls` relationships and its own attribution counters

knownLimitation.what: 66,394 calls are not attributed to any symbol, which is 61.7% of all call sites
knownLimitation.why: R packages are mostly top-level code, so most calls have no enclosing function; `source` in this framework's relationship model is a symbol name, and there is no symbol to name
knownLimitation.decision: DESIGN LIMITATION, recorded rather than silently accepted. Attributing file-scope calls to the FILE, as file-level `imports` edges already do, is the available alternative and is a framework semantics decision, not this lane's to take alone.
